5-Step System

The Dexon Sales Framework

Every client we take on moves through the same five stages — the same ones we've used ourselves across 17 years and 45+ countries.

01

Mindset of the Exporter

Before strategy, we reset how you think about global trade — the beliefs that stop most first-time exporters from ever closing a deal.

02

Ultimate Product Selection

What you export — and how you position it — matters more than most exporters realise. We get this right first.

03

Country Selection

Not every market wants your product. We identify the countries with real, provable demand for it.

04

Buyer Hunting & Communication

Finding a buyer is half the job. Knowing how to talk to one — in their language of trust — is what closes it.

05

Scaling

From your first container to your fiftieth — we build the systems that let export income keep compounding.
